name: RAYGUN
old_description: New releases, jokes, sales ... honestly, this is the best newsletter you'll get.
about:
RAYGUN operates from Des Moines, Iowa. According to company records, the business traces its origins to 1857, though the current retail brand appears to be a more recent incarnation. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company runs an e-commerce storefront specializing in Des Moines and Iowa-themed apparel and accessories. Its catalog spans t-shirts, hoodies, hats, mugs, stickers, tote bags, pint glasses, and enamel pins. Designs reference local landmarks such as the Iowa Capitol and East Village, as well as collegiate partners including Drake University, Iowa State University, and the University of Iowa. The store also carries pride-themed items and humorous slogans like "Des Moines Hates Nazis" and "Des Moines Is Pretty Gay."

RAYGUN sells directly to consumers through its website and offers a pickup option for local customers. Its audience includes Des Moines residents, university alumni, visitors seeking souvenirs, and fans of Midwest culture. The product mix targets both casual wear and gift markets, with price points ranging from $2.90 for stickers to $49 for hoodies.

The brand promotes a no-questions-asked return policy covering product cost and shipping without restocking fees, and highlights a newsletter described as "the greatest newsletter in the Universe" featuring new releases, jokes, and sales.
built_on: No-restocking-fee returns covering product and shipping costs
Local pickup available for Des Moines customers
Extensive catalog of Des Moines and Iowa-themed designs
Collegiate licensing for Drake, Iowa State, and University of Iowa

name: RC Metal Works Inc
old_description: At RC Metalworks, we are specialists in sheet metal fabrication and ductwork for commercial and industrial HVAC systems. Our experienced craftsman can fabricate ductwork and other custom metalwork from galvanized steel, aluminum, stainless steel, black iron, copper, and lead coated copper. Our clients, located in Rhode Island (RI), Massachusetts (MA), and Connecticut (CT), include hospitals, universities, laboratories, governments, commercial developments, residential developments, and heavy industry.
about:
RC Metal Works Inc, doing business as RC Metalworks, operates from Johnston, Rhode Island. The company has delivered sheet metal fabrication and ductwork services since 1987, focusing on commercial and industrial HVAC systems.

The shop fabricates ductwork and custom metal components from galvanized steel, aluminum, stainless steel, black iron, copper, and lead-coated copper. Its capabilities include SMACNA-standard ductwork, custom sheet metal orders, ductwork installation, and repair services for all metal types. The team handles projects ranging from standard air ducts to custom panels, drain pans, machine guards, cupola covers, and steel frames, working from customer sketches or specifications.

Clients span hospitals, universities, laboratories, government facilities, commercial and residential developments, and heavy industry across Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Connecticut. The company coordinates installation and repairs around operating hours to minimize disruption for facilities such as hospitals and universities.

RC Metalworks emphasizes craftsmanship, precision, and deep HVAC expertise. All ductwork is fabricated to SMACNA standards with a full review of fabrication quality, sealing, fit, and structural integrity before completion. Post-installation airflow testing and adjustment ensure long-term performance.

name: RDI Foods, LLC
old_description: is a contract consulting company which specializes in all aspects of food product research, development,
about:
RDI Foods, LLC is a food consulting firm based in Raleigh, North Carolina. Founded in June 2002 by Dr. Richard "Rody" Hawkins after 17 years at ConAgra Foods and Philip Morris (Kraft Foods), the company was created as a resource to help food companies solve problems, create value, and improve margins. The principals—Dr. Hawkins, Larry Chandler (food process and project management), Steve Klawiter (packaging systems), and Dr. Sarid Shefet (innovative food processing)—collectively hold over 85 years of industry experience and 28 patents.

The firm specializes in food product research, development, and plant implementation. It designs and coordinates innovative solutions for established food companies, including new product and process development for domestic and international markets, cross-functional team leadership for production launches, raw material cost reduction, process efficiency improvements, and shelf-life evaluation. RDI Foods also develops and implements Safe Quality Food (SQF) programs, and has expertise in military product development and specification writing under a Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) with the U.S. Army Soldier Systems Command in Natick, Massachusetts.

Clients span the food industry, from commercial manufacturers of shelf-stable and preserved foods to the U.S. military. The company has worked with the U.S. Army since 1993 on shelf-stable sandwiches, earning an Excellence in Research Award. It also partners with food companies on joint ventures, sharing profits from co-developed products. Examples include pepperoni and pizza production consulting, and projects for five food companies in a 12-month period.

RDI Foods distinguishes itself through its principals' deep technical expertise in shelf-stable foods, processing, and packaging, combined with a consulting model that moves beyond advice to hands-on implementation in production environments. The firm's SQF programs have been recognized as industry models, and its military R&D track record demonstrates capability in high-stakes, regulated product development.

name: REO Plastics Inc
old_description: REO Plastics was founded by Robert E O’Connor, whose initials created the name, REO.
about:
REO Plastics Inc operates from Maple Grove, Minnesota. The company was founded by Robert E. O'Connor, whose initials gave the firm its name. The founding year is not publicly disclosed, and ownership details have not been specified.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding, offering end-to-end services from product development and design for manufacturability through prototype to production manufacturing. Its capabilities include plastic machining (CNC milling and EDM), plastic material decoration, assembly and verification testing, and stocking/fulfillment. Equipment includes a 950-ton injection molding press, a CNC electric robot for molding automation, and advanced automation systems. Facility size and employee count are not disclosed.

Customers range from large manufacturing firms to small startups, with testimonials citing long-term partnerships spanning over 25 years. The company serves clients in sectors requiring precision plastic components, though specific industry verticals are not listed.

REO Plastics emphasizes its core values of quality, service, and productivity, aiming to build long-term partnerships. It differentiates itself through flexible, end-to-end injection molding services, complimentary value-added services such as machining and decoration, and advanced automation equipment that enables it to handle projects of varying size and complexity.

name: RES: Renewable Energy Services, Inc
old_description: Building solar power systems with technical expertise for the long-term benefit of our community.
about:
Renewable Energy Services, Inc. (RES) was incorporated in 1992 in Honokaa, on the Big Island of Hawaii. For over three decades the company has focused on bringing solar power to the island community, operating from its base in Honokaa.

RES designs, installs, and maintains both grid-tied and off-grid photovoltaic systems, along with mobile power solutions. The firm also provides troubleshooting, repair, and consulting services, taking a technology-oriented approach that includes vetting equipment and developing performance simulation software to ensure reliable system design.

The company primarily serves residential customers on the Big Island, with long-term clients such as Carolyn Lancaster, who has worked with RES since 2002, and Donald Mott, a client since 2006. Its work emphasizes energy resiliency and local economic benefit for Hawaiian homeowners.

RES distinguishes itself through a commitment to transparency and service that exceeds industry standards.

name: RFiD Discovery USA & Canada
old_description: RFiD Discovery is a leading provider of integrated location tracking solutions using latest technologies including active and passive RFID, BLE, UWB, GPS, Wi-Fi and more.
about:
RFiD Discovery operates from Essex Junction, Vermont, as the North American arm of RFiD Discovery Solutions Ltd, a subsidiary of Paragon ID. The company was established as a trading name for RFID tracking solutions, though a founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership rests with Paragon ID, a global identification solutions group.

The firm delivers integrated location-tracking systems that combine active and passive RFID, Bluetooth Low Energy, ultra-wideband, GPS, Wi-Fi, and LoRa technologies. As an independent systems provider, it designs and deploys hardware-software platforms for asset tracking, inventory management, work-in-progress monitoring, and personnel safety across facilities. The company cites a 15-year track record in healthcare RFID and deployments in over 100 hospitals across the UK and Europe.

Customers span healthcare, manufacturing, logistics, oil and gas, construction, retail, mining, and aviation. Reference installations include syringe-pump tracking for North Midlands NHS Trust, R&D inventory management for Sanofi, medical-device auditing for Gateshead Health NHS Foundation Trust, and garment container verification for clothing manufacturer Brook Taverner.

The company differentiates itself through a technology-agnostic approach that selects the optimal mix of tracking methods for each application, backed by Paragon ID's ISO 9001, 14001, 27001, and 45001 certifications.

old_description: At RK Design we handcraft custom furniture tailored to fit your needs. Focused on you the customer, we strive to deliver you a heirloom piece that will not only be stunning but will stand the test of time.
about:
RK Design and Supply LLC operates from Eagan, Minnesota, where it handcrafts custom furniture and home goods. The company does not publish a founding year, but its website emphasizes a philosophy of building heirloom pieces tailored to each customer’s space, budget, and style. The owner, identified as Ryan in customer testimonials, works directly with clients to develop one‑of‑a‑kind items.

The shop produces a range of wood products including countertops, tables, shelves, cutting boards, engraved signs, and assorted home‑decor items. Work is described as handcrafted, and the team uses laser engraving to add personalized graphics or logos to wood slices that retain their natural bark. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Customers are primarily residential buyers seeking custom gifts or statement pieces for their homes. A testimonial describes a custom wall‑hanging sign given as a holiday present, illustrating the direct‑to‑consumer nature of the business. The company does not list commercial or industrial clients.

RK Design says it differentiates itself by focusing on the customer’s specific needs — discussing space, budget, style, and color — to deliver furniture that is both visually striking and durable enough to last generations.

RN Design operates from Bozeman, Montana, where it has built a reputation for handcrafted bunk rooms and custom bars. The firm is led by designer Jason, who heads a team that creates one-of-a-kind interior installations for homes and businesses.

The company designs and fabricates custom bunk rooms, bunk beds, furniture, and themed interiors, with a particular focus on bars made from live-edge walnut slabs, sleek oak, and vintage truck components fitted with custom lighting. Projects range from residential sleeping spaces to commercial hospitality installations, all produced in their workshop using woodworking and metalworking processes.

The firm serves both residential and commercial sectors, delivering tailored pieces that integrate into larger building projects or stand alone as focal points.

RN Design emphasizes handcrafted, high-end luxury and the ability to translate a client's vision into a finished piece, promoting designs that are "uniquely you" rather than following catalog templates.

name: RPC Electronics - Electronic Manufacturing & Supply Chain Services
old_description: Offering domestic and off-shore manufacturing, RPC Electronics specializes in custom wire harnesses, and panel building for industrial, medical, and commercial markets…
about:
RPC Electronics is based in Chagrin Falls, Ohio, and traces its roots to 1932 when it began with a focus on assembly and services. The company is now owned by an international, privately held family of companies that operates facilities in the United States, Mexico, and China.

The firm provides printed circuit board assembly, electromechanical assembly, panel building, custom wire harnesses, LCD display and embedded computing systems, and PCB design services. Its 20,000-square-foot audited warehouse and assembly areas support processes such as automated assembly, point-to-point wiring, component programming, component sourcing, conformal coating, and board fabrication. Both domestic and off-shore manufacturing options are offered.

RPC serves industrial OEMs across sectors including industrial, medical, commercial, telecommunications, instrumentation, gaming, network communication, industrial automation, lighting and motion control, automotive, and aerospace. The company also provides kitting and obsolescence design services to support long-term product lifecycles.

The company emphasizes 'valuable efficiency' through secure, per-customer production areas and 'stable but innovative' expertise as a focused electronics sourcing partner, promising immediate response to challenging requirements.

name: RST Custom Woodworking LLC
old_description: Once upon a time, builders took great pride in mastering the details of their trade. In fact, they were not just builders. They were experts. They were artisans. They were craftsmen. And the homes they built were not simply dwelling places, but works of art. It may be tempting to think these days are behind us, but we're here to demonstrate they're not.
about:
RST Custom Woodworking LLC, operating as Modern-day Craftsmen, was founded in 1995 in Indianapolis, Indiana. The company began as a custom woodworking shop under the leadership of cousins Trevor Remster and Rod Cooper, who reconnected after college to build a business focused on artisanal wood products.

The firm produces custom stairways, cabinetry, crown moulding, and furniture, and has expanded into full custom home construction and remodeling. A team of more than 30 employees, many with over two decades of tenure, executes projects from conceptual design through final installation, working with or without pre-existing blueprints.

The company serves residential clients seeking custom-built homes, renovations, or standalone woodwork pieces. Its portfolio spans new custom home builds, whole-house remodels, and specialized millwork for homeowners across Indiana.

Modern-day Craftsmen distinguishes itself by offering engagement at any project stage — from pre-design consultation to mid-construction intervention — and by maintaining a stable, highly skilled workforce that enables a craftsmanship-first approach rather than standardized production.
